narrative: On the board. The same sheet, a third of it filled, still no blot. Two houses are in the street now. Your hand is in the margin and is not striking a line. The cat is a grey weight on the other book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the thumb and the cry and struck nothing.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
entities.context: Shown on draft in The thumb, and the cry
